Back.meaning: leave a screen and keep any draft on the device; pure navigation

Clear.meaning: discard the draft; a text action, present only while a draft exists

Close.meaning: leave a sheet that saves per tap; names the sheet, not the data

Edit.meaning: correct something already posted; stamped, original kept, corrected value amber

End task.meaning: close the task for the batch; manual only, hold-to-commit, with a receipt

Finish.meaning: end a farrowing; always written 'Finish farrowing' (the object names what ends)

Lock.meaning: freeze Born at the end of farrowing; hold-to-commit

Move.meaning: move n piglets from one litter to another in one record that changes both litters

Review.meaning: open what an act will write, per subject, before it is recorded; commits nothing

Save.meaning: commit a staged draft as one stamped event

Scan.meaning: read an ear tag with the camera

Set count.meaning: assert the head count seen; the difference is written as an unexplained gain or loss

Tick.meaning: choose subjects for one act on several (a bulk record); nothing is recorded until Record

Type.meaning: enter a tag or notch by hand instead of scanning

banned.Submit: every action commits itself; name the act (Record, Save, End task)
banned.Confirm: name the act instead; the DS README's 'Confirm & next' example is superseded by the rulings
banned.Complete: rooms and tasks are ended, not completed; say End task or Finish farrowing; the DS README's 'Complete' ban stands
